title: Wildfire Watch
description: *Wildfire Watch* is a **wildfire map for Catalonia built to judge risk**, not only to show where fires are. It runs on demo data for now.

Each hotspot is sized by its radiative power and checked against a second satellite. A timeline shows the past size and a **forecast spread stretched along the wind**, and alerts name every town within 10 km of a fire.
The danger score, spread shape and alerts are **pure modules covered by tests written before the code**, so real data sources can replace the demo without touching the map.
imageAlt: A map of Catalonia with a fire near Berga and its forecast spread stretched along the wind
